© Roscosmos / Lavochkin / IKI / NASA NSSDCA archive. Venera 13 launched 1981-10-30 from Baikonur. After a 122-day cruise the descent capsule separated and braked through Venus's atmosphere using parachutes, then a final aero-brake disc; it landed 1982-03-01 at 7.5°S 303°E in the Phoebe Regio highlands. Surface conditions at touchdown: 457 °C, 89 atm, sulfuric-acid haze. Venera 13 survived 127 minutes — the longest surface survival of any Venus mission, beating its design target by about 95 minutes. During that window it returned the first colour panoramic images of another planet's surface (two 180° colour panoramas), recorded the first audio from another planet's surface via wind-microphone, and used its drill + onboard XRF to determine that the landing site basalt was a weakly differentiated leucite alkaline composition. Twin spacecraft Venera 14 (launched 1981-11-04, landed 1982-03-05) performed nearly identical operations at a different site. The Venera series — Venera 4 through 16 (1967-1983) — remains the only successful surface program at Venus to date.

在福柏区 7.5°南303°东着陆；在457°C / 89个大气压下进行127分钟的表面操作。
所有金星任务中最长的表面生存时间（127分钟）；其他行星表面首次彩色全景图像和首次音频

苏联 Venera 计划的巅峰。Venera 13 于1981年10月30日发射，1982年3月1日在福柏区高地的南纬 7.5°、东经 303° 处着陆。着陆时的地表条件：457 °C、89 个大气压、硫酸雾霾。着陆器存活了 127 分钟——约为 32 分钟设计寿命的四倍——传回了另一颗行星表面的首批彩色全景图，用麦克风录下风声，并用钻头和机载 X 射线荧光光谱仪测定，着陆点的玄武岩是弱分异的白榴石碱性成分。孪生探测器 Venera 14 五天后在另一地点完成了同样的操作。Venera 系列（1967–1983）至今仍是金星上唯一成功的地表探测计划。
